family_title_en: Delete the sound in a word

stages.ix_title: Delete the sound in a word

what_to_do.en: Tap the word that is left.

stages.choice_rule: Four different whole words from the roots list or allowed_extra_words. Exactly one is the word left after the named sound is taken off. Move the answer slot from item to item. Tier 1 wrong words are unrelated. Tier 2 wrong words share most sounds with the answer. Tier 3 wrong words are the starting word or the word left when a different sound is taken off.

gold_items.stem: Take the first sound off cat.
Take the first sound off pan.
Take the first sound off cup.
Take the first sound off stop.
Take the last sound off farm.
Take the first sound off away.
Take the second sound off the word black.
Take the last sound off the word plant.

roots: Four real whole words. Never a bare sound, a single letter, IPA, or a made-up spelling.
Exactly one choice is correct. If two choices could both be left, write a new item.
Tier 1 wrong choices are easy kid words that do not sound like the answer.
Tier 2 wrong choices keep a chunk of the answer, such as the same first sound or a rhyme.
Tier 3 wrong choices are near misses: the starting word, or the leftover from taking off the wrong sound.
No brand names. If a stem needs a child, use <NAME> and never a real name.

tier_rules.1: Stem is Take the first sound off plus a three-sound word. Six words. Wrong choices are unrelated kid words.
tier_rules.2: Take the first sound off a blend or a two-syllable word, or the last sound off a short word. Wrong choices share most sounds with the answer.
tier_rules.3: Longer stem, eight to ten words, naming the word. Take off the second sound or the last sound. Wrong choices are the starting word or a one-sound miss.

drop_first.en: Take off the first sound. Keep the other sounds in the same order.
drop_first.ko: 첫 소리를 빼세요. 다른 소리는 같은 순서로 두세요.

drop_last.en: Take off the last sound. Keep every sound that comes before it.
drop_last.ko: 마지막 소리를 빼세요. 그 앞의 소리는 모두 두세요.

drop_second.en: Take off the second sound only. Keep the first sound and the rest.
drop_second.ko: 두 번째 소리만 빼세요. 첫 소리와 나머지는 두세요.
